meanings: to remove, take off, scrape, rubout, pack, tear with the beak. nasran - eagle/vulture, idol in the shape of an eagle.

occurrences.verseTransliteration: Ve kâlû lâ tezerunne âlihetekum ve lâ tezerrunne vedden ve lâ suvâan ve lâ yegûse ve yeûka ve nesrâ(nesren).
